goal: Deploy Wazuh all-in-one on Ubuntu Server and establish the centralized monitoring foundation.
definition_of_done: Ubuntu is prepared for Wazuh deployment, Wazuh all-in-one installation completes successfully, Manage, indexer, and dashboard services are operational, Required service ports and network access are verified, Dashboard is accessible from the physical Windows host, or any remaining access blocker is identified and documented.
dependencies: Ubuntu Server 26.04.1 LTS, hostname ubuntu-siem01, SSH access, working internet and DNS, sufficient disk space, available host memory, Wazuh installation compatibility with the installed Ubuntu release.
